finding: All three synthetic price profiles choose the same immediate mate on four scoped roots. P/N/B features are absent at every visited position; these tasks cannot identify their relative prices through this material evaluator.
limits: Finite exact random-opponent tree is a diagnostic oracle, not a replacement for the intended mature-engine experiment.
Selective mature search may react to numerical leaf scales through pruning/order/caches; that is conditional search behavior, not proof these rewards uniquely identify values.
This does not refute fast-mate objectives on full-army positions or broader distributions involving all types and exchanges.
Roots are declared constructed witnesses, not random games, independent human holdout or estimates of prevalence.
